summary: Found one blocking snapshot defect. Reviewed requirements, README, task ownership, and test changes; eight focused tests passed using existing binaries. Full torture and reference engines were not rerun.

findings.finding: Thrill queues draws as SpellMove to Hand, but snapshot_work_valid in snapshot.rs:192–201 accepts SpellMove only to Battlefield or Graveyard. With at least two library cards, resolve using apply_turn_quantum(..., NonZeroUsize::MIN), then immediately snapshot and restore: the second draw remains queued, so restore returns Corrupt for a valid engine-produced snapshot. Update validation to accept legitimate draw work and add a regression at this first yield. The current test at casting_tests.rs:833 resumes again before snapshotting, skipping the failing boundary.
